qaris.name: Qari Nazrul Islam
qaris.title: Hafiz & Qari
qaris.tagline: Dedicated to spreading the recitation of the Quran throughout the New York community
qaris.bio:
Qari Nazrul Islam has been a pillar of Quranic education in the New York Muslim community for many years. He completed his hifz at a young age and went on to pursue formal training in the rules of Tajweed under senior scholars.

He is known for his warm teaching style and his dedication to students of all ages and backgrounds. His classes draw students from across the city who seek to improve their recitation and connection with the Quran.

Qari Nazrul is actively involved in the local masjid community and regularly leads Taraweeh prayers during the blessed month of Ramadan.
